title: GOD IS GOOD TO ME

lines.text: Jesus as a lamb was slain,
He delivered me, cleansed and set me free,
Lord of all, He rose again.
Now I live, yet not I,
God has shown His love for me.

lyrics:
[Verse 1]
God is good to me,
Oh what love I see,
Jesus as a lamb was slain,
He delivered me, cleansed and set me free,
Lord of all, He rose again.
Now I live, yet not I,
Jesus is alive in me,
Sending the Spirit's flame
Into my heart again,
God has shown His love for me.
